capture.announce: 🔴 Recording **{channel}** for meeting notes. Everyone in this voice channel is recorded per speaker and transcribed locally. Use `/meeting stop` to end it.
capture.busy: I'm already connected to a voice channel in this server (for example via `/voice join`). Run `/voice leave` first, then start the recording again.
capture.discord_only: Live recording works only from Discord.
capture.incompatible: Live recording is disabled: this Hermes version changed voice internals the scribe relies on ({detail}). Run `hermes meeting-scribe doctor`.
capture.join_voice_first: Join a voice channel first, or pass one: `/meeting start #voice-channel`.
capture.no_guild: Run this inside a Discord server channel (not a DM).
capture.not_connected: Discord is not connected yet; try again in a moment.
capture.stopped: ⏹️ Recording stopped ({reason}). Meeting `{id}` is being processed; notes will be posted here.
capture.target_not_found: No voice channel “{target}” in this server.
capture.timeout: Discord did not answer in time; check `/meeting status`.
cli.setup_intro: meeting-scribe setup — press Enter to keep the value in brackets.
cli.setup_language_hint: Pinning the spoken language is strongly recommended: auto-detect can flip mid-meeting.
cmd.capture_unavailable: Live recording is not available in this installation yet (capture module not installed). Processing, search and reprocess work.
cmd.help:
**/{cmd}** — meeting scribe
`start [#voice]` record · `stop` finish · `status` · `list [n]` · `show <id>` · `search <text>` · `reprocess <id> [from=transcribe|analyze|deliver]` · `link @user <linear email or name>` · `project <id> <project>` · `config` · `help`
cmd.project_saved: Meeting `{id}` assigned to project “{project}”; channel mapping learned.
cmd.reprocess_bad_stage: Unknown stage `{stage}`. Use transcribe, analyze or deliver.
notes.partial: Recording was interrupted; notes may be incomplete.
sink.linear_inactive: Linear is not connected (no LINEAR_API_KEY and no allowlisted `linear` MCP server).
transcript.title: Transcript — {title}
